crossRefs.note: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of…
“Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those…
How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.

translations.web: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.
translations.bsb: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.
translations.kjv: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
translations.asv: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without: neither is this a work of one day or two; for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.
